completion.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"L001","correct":true,"reason":"Matches: failure to maintain clearance from trees due to sun glare."},{"id":"L023","correct":true,"reason":"Failure to set throttle friction lock plus parking brake malfunction, matching reference."},{"id":"L034","correct":false,"reason":"Mentions high density altitude but gives no probable cause, omits gusting wind and pilot's decision/lack of experience; hedges and speculates about landing on road."},{"id":"L045","correct":true,"reason":"Matches decision to depart contaminated runway, failure to abort, limited visibility contributing."},{"id":"L078","correct":true,"reason":"Improper landing flare and remedial action causing hard bounced landing."},{"id":"L089","correct":false,"reason":"Describes engine damage but explicitly does not identify oil starvation as cause; does not convey the reference cause."},{"id":"L100","correct":true,"reason":"Fatigue crack of left main gear spring with improper maintenance allowing corrosion."},{"id":"S001","correct":true,"reason":"Identifies one fatal Part 121 accident, Southwest 1380 (DCA18MA142), matching count of 1."},{"id":"S014","correct":true,"reason":"Identifies WPR18MA087 as the only one."},{"id":"S027","correct":true,"reason":"Identifies WPR24FA112."},{"id":"S040","correct":false,"reason":"Answered zero; reference count is 6."},{"id":"A001","correct":true,"reason":"Covers carb ice conditions, use of carb heat, glide/low power; consistent with reference, though framed around pilot practices rather than explicit failure to apply heat."},{"id":"A002","correct":true,"reason":"Covers VFR into IMC causing spatial disorientation, non-instrument-rated pilots, often fatal."},{"id":"A003","correct":false,"reason":"Claims excerpts show no water-in-fuel engine failures; contradicts reference that water contamination caused power loss."}]}
